messages:
sam: Quick update — sliding the ship window by ~3h. E2E flaky on canary is blocking a safe version bump. New ETA Wed 14:00 PT. Can folks post blockers / WIP PRs here? I'll hold public announcements until canary is green. /cc @maria-marketing
jess: Seeing flaky failure: `test/session-timeout` on x86 gpu runners. Looks like a race in KV cache invalidation. Pushed reproducer: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4821
kai: Looking into the reproducer now. I can revert the cache tweak if needed, but prefer a targeted fix. Est ~1.5h to patch + CI.
deploy-bot: canary deploy failed: 2/5 instances unhealthy (liveness). Logs: `timeout in runtime/kv_cache.go:214`
lena: Heads up — don't publish release notes yet. We still need changelog entries from analytics/docs. @docs can you confirm PRs are merged? Also remember to bump version after changelog is final.
jess: docs PRs linked here: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pulls — docs team says OK to land after the fix.
sam: Plan: kai lands fix, wait for canary green, then I run version bump + tag. Local steps I use: ```bash
git checkout release-candidate
npm version patch -m "chore(release): %s"
git push --follow-tags
``` Please don't force-push release-candidate until I tag.
kai: Working now — will push branch `fix/e2e-kv-race` in ~20m.
jess: Also noticed CI shows `libai` minor mismatch. Opened #4823 to pin the dependency.
maria-marketing: @sam — thanks. Please hold the public announcement until you confirm final tag. We'll have the copy ready but won't send it yet.
sam: Thanks. If canary is green by 14:00 PT I will proceed and post in #announcements. If not, I'll update again. @lena please nudge docs/analytics for changelog entries by EOD :pray:
lena: On it — pinged analytics in #customer-success.
deploy-bot: canary status update: now 5/5 healthy. New build: 2100004350. Running integration smoke tests.
kai: Patch pushed and merged to release-candidate: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4830 — works on local repro; CI looking good so far.
jess: Smoke tests passed. All green.
sam: Confirmed. Proceeding with version bump and tagging now. Will post exact tag and ETA in ~10m. Thanks everyone :tada:
